notes: G3 spec (amount+1 and controller YOU->OPPONENT on the block trigger's draw mode). Printed: 'Whenever this creature attacks or blocks, choose one - ... Draw a card.' On the opponent's turn Elder Gargaroth blocks the opponent's 2/2 and its controller chooses 'Draw a card': seat 0 draws exactly one (hand 1 -> 2: the opening draw plus this one); seat 1 keeps only its own draw-step card (1). No Beast token.
